papers.title: Taming the reference genome jungle: the refget sequence collection standard
papers.summary: Abstract Motivation Reference genomes are foundational to genomics but suffer from widespread ambiguity and incompatibility due to inconsistent naming, undocumented differences, and lack of formal mechanisms for comparison. Results To address this, we introduce the GA4GH refget Sequence Collections (seqcol) standard. Refget seqcol is a framework for unambiguous representation, retrieval, and comparison of sequence collections such as reference genomes and transcriptomes. The seqcol standard comprises four components: a structured data schema, a canonical encoding algorithm that produces content-based, globally unique identifiers, a retrieval API, and a comparison protocol. This standard enables precise identification of sequence collections, even across decentralized or private systems, and allows compatibility assessments beyond exact identity, such as order-relaxed matches or shared coordinate systems. We applied the refget seqcol standard to 60 human and 36 mouse reference genomes sourced from major providers. Using digest-based comparisons, we quantified levels of similarity across attributes including sequence names, lengths, coordinate systems, and actual sequence content. Our analysis revealed some consistent subsets of sequences or coordinate systems, as well as substantial incompatibility among references and duplicate references under different names. This work offers a scalable, reproducible solution to the reference genome compatibility crisis, enabling improved transparency, reuse, and integration in genomic analyses. Refget seqcol enhances interoperability across tools and datasets, making genomic research more robust and reproducible. Availability and Implementation To support adoption of refget seqcol, we provide a Python package implementing the full standard, a web API, and a comparison interface allowing users to assess local references against a curated database. The formal specification is hosted at https://ga4gh.github.io/refget/ and the reference implementation can be found at https://github.com/refgenie/refget

RESULTS: To address this, we introduce the GA4GH refget Sequence Collections (seqcol) standard. Refget seqcol is a framework for unambiguous representation, retrieval, and comparison of sequence collections such as reference genomes and transcriptomes. The seqcol standard comprises four components: a structured data schema, a canonical encoding algorithm that produces content-based, globally unique identifiers, a retrieval API, and a comparison protocol. This standard enables precise identification of sequence collections, even across decentralized or private systems, and allows compatibility assessments beyond exact identity, such as order-relaxed matches or shared coordinate systems. We applied the refget seqcol standard to 60 human and 36 mouse reference genomes sourced from major providers. Using digest-based comparisons, we quantified levels of similarity across attributes including sequence names, lengths, coordinate systems, and actual sequence content. Our analysis revealed some consistent subsets of sequences or coordinate systems, as well as substantial incompatibility among references and duplicate references under different names. This work offers a scalable, reproducible solution to the reference genome compatibility crisis, enabling improved transparency, reuse, and integration in genomic analyses. Refget seqcol enhances interoperability across tools and datasets, making genomic research more robust and reproducible.

AVAILABILITY AND IMPLEMENTATION: To support adoption of refget seqcol, we provide a Python package implementing the full standard, a web API, and a comparison interface allowing users to assess local references against a curated database. The formal specification is hosted at https://ga4gh.github.io/refget/ and the reference implementation can be found at https://github.com/refgenie/refget.

papers.llm_title_zh: 驯服参考基因组丛林：refget 序列收集标准
papers.llm_title_bilingual: 驯服参考基因组丛林：refget 序列收集标准 / Taming the reference genome jungle: the refget sequence collection standard
papers.llm_research_question_zh: 参考基因组是基因组学的基础，但由于命名不一致、未记录的差异以及缺乏正式的比较机制，参考基因组普遍存在模糊性和不兼容性。
llm_highlights_zh: 为了解决这个问题，我们引入了 GA4GH refget 序列集合 (seqcol) 标准。
Refget seqcol 是一个用于明确表示、检索和比较序列集合（例如参考基因组和转录组）的框架。
seqcol 标准包含四个组件：结构化数据模式、生成基于内容的全局唯一标识符的规范编码算法、检索 API 和比较协议。
papers.llm_rss_summary_zh: 参考基因组是基因组学的基础，但由于命名不一致、未记录的差异以及缺乏正式的比较机制，因此存在广泛的模糊性和不兼容性。结果为了解决这个问题，我们引入了 GA4GH refget 序列集合 (seqcol) 标准。 Refget seqcol 是一个用于明确表示、检索和比较序列集合（例如参考基因组和转录组）的框架。 seqcol 标准包含四个组件：结构化数据模式、生成基于内容的全局唯一标识符的规范编码算法、检索 API 和比较协议。该标准甚至可以跨分散或私有系统实现序列集合的精确识别，并允许超越精确身份的兼容性评估，例如顺序宽松的匹配或共享坐标系。我们将 refget seqcol 标准应用于来自主要提供商的 60 个人类和 36 个小鼠参考基因组。使用基于摘要的比较，我们量化了属性之间的相似性水平，包括序列名称、长度、坐标系和实际序列内容。我们的分析揭示了序列或坐标系的一些一致子集，以及不同名称下的参考文献和重复参考文献之间的实质性不兼容性。这项工作为参考基因组兼容性危机提供了可扩展、可重复的解决方案，从而提高了基因组分析的透明度、重用性和集成性。 Refget seqcol 增强了工具和数据集之间的互操作性，使基因组研究更加稳健和可重复。 可用性和实施​​ 为了支持 refget seqcol 的采用，我们提供了一个实施完整标准的 Python 包、一个 Web API 和一个比较接口，允许用户根据精选数据库评估本地引用。正式规范托管在 https://ga4gh.github.io/refget/ ，参考实现可以在 https://github.com/refgenie/refget 找到

all_papers.title: Taming the reference genome jungle: the refget sequence collection standard
all_papers.summary: Abstract Motivation Reference genomes are foundational to genomics but suffer from widespread ambiguity and incompatibility due to inconsistent naming, undocumented differences, and lack of formal mechanisms for comparison. Results To address this, we introduce the GA4GH refget Sequence Collections (seqcol) standard. Refget seqcol is a framework for unambiguous representation, retrieval, and comparison of sequence collections such as reference genomes and transcriptomes. The seqcol standard comprises four components: a structured data schema, a canonical encoding algorithm that produces content-based, globally unique identifiers, a retrieval API, and a comparison protocol. This standard enables precise identification of sequence collections, even across decentralized or private systems, and allows compatibility assessments beyond exact identity, such as order-relaxed matches or shared coordinate systems. We applied the refget seqcol standard to 60 human and 36 mouse reference genomes sourced from major providers. Using digest-based comparisons, we quantified levels of similarity across attributes including sequence names, lengths, coordinate systems, and actual sequence content. Our analysis revealed some consistent subsets of sequences or coordinate systems, as well as substantial incompatibility among references and duplicate references under different names. This work offers a scalable, reproducible solution to the reference genome compatibility crisis, enabling improved transparency, reuse, and integration in genomic analyses. Refget seqcol enhances interoperability across tools and datasets, making genomic research more robust and reproducible. Availability and Implementation To support adoption of refget seqcol, we provide a Python package implementing the full standard, a web API, and a comparison interface allowing users to assess local references against a curated database. The formal specification is hosted at https://ga4gh.github.io/refget/ and the reference implementation can be found at https://github.com/refgenie/refget

all_papers.llm_title_zh: 驯服参考基因组丛林：refget 序列收集标准
all_papers.llm_title_bilingual: 驯服参考基因组丛林：refget 序列收集标准 / Taming the reference genome jungle: the refget sequence collection standard
all_papers.llm_research_question_zh: 参考基因组是基因组学的基础，但由于命名不一致、未记录的差异以及缺乏正式的比较机制，参考基因组普遍存在模糊性和不兼容性。
llm_highlights_zh: 为了解决这个问题，我们引入了 GA4GH refget 序列集合 (seqcol) 标准。
Refget seqcol 是一个用于明确表示、检索和比较序列集合（例如参考基因组和转录组）的框架。
seqcol 标准包含四个组件：结构化数据模式、生成基于内容的全局唯一标识符的规范编码算法、检索 API 和比较协议。
all_papers.llm_rss_summary_zh: 参考基因组是基因组学的基础，但由于命名不一致、未记录的差异以及缺乏正式的比较机制，因此存在广泛的模糊性和不兼容性。结果为了解决这个问题，我们引入了 GA4GH refget 序列集合 (seqcol) 标准。 Refget seqcol 是一个用于明确表示、检索和比较序列集合（例如参考基因组和转录组）的框架。 seqcol 标准包含四个组件：结构化数据模式、生成基于内容的全局唯一标识符的规范编码算法、检索 API 和比较协议。该标准甚至可以跨分散或私有系统实现序列集合的精确识别，并允许超越精确身份的兼容性评估，例如顺序宽松的匹配或共享坐标系。我们将 refget seqcol 标准应用于来自主要提供商的 60 个人类和 36 个小鼠参考基因组。使用基于摘要的比较，我们量化了属性之间的相似性水平，包括序列名称、长度、坐标系和实际序列内容。我们的分析揭示了序列或坐标系的一些一致子集，以及不同名称下的参考文献和重复参考文献之间的实质性不兼容性。这项工作为参考基因组兼容性危机提供了可扩展、可重复的解决方案，从而提高了基因组分析的透明度、重用性和集成性。 Refget seqcol 增强了工具和数据集之间的互操作性，使基因组研究更加稳健和可重复。 可用性和实施​​ 为了支持 refget seqcol 的采用，我们提供了一个实施完整标准的 Python 包、一个 Web API 和一个比较接口，允许用户根据精选数据库评估本地引用。正式规范托管在 https://ga4gh.github.io/refget/ ，参考实现可以在 https://github.com/refgenie/refget 找到
